title: armeria maritima var. planifolia
intro: Armeria maritima var. planifolia, commonly known as Sea Thrift, is a low-growing, perennial plant native to coastal areas in Europe and North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima var. planifolia are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, ease respiratory problems, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
